description: This file appears to be a Perl module implementing diff highlighting functionality, particularly for visualizing code differences with color in terminal output. It includes methods for handling diff hunks, highlighting line pairs, and managing terminal color sequences.

methods.name: visible_width
methods.description: Calculates the visible width of a string excluding terminal color sequences.

methods.name: visible_substr
methods.description: Returns a substring of the input string omitting a specified number of visible characters, ignoring terminal color sequences.

methods.name: handle_line
methods.description: Processes a line of diff output, managing highlighting and hunks.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes queued diff hunks for output.

methods.name: highlight_stdin
methods.description: Reads diff data from STDIN and processes it line by line for highlighting.

methods.name: color_config
methods.description: Retrieves color configuration from git config or defaults.

methods.name: show_hunk
methods.description: Displays a diff hunk with highlighting.

methods.name: split_line
methods.description: Splits a line into tokens based on color sequences.

methods.name: highlight_line
methods.description: Applies color highlighting to parts of a line.

methods.name: is_pair_interesting
methods.description: Determines if a pair of lines is interesting enough to highlight.
